item.title: Patch now: Synology DSM Vulnerabilities Allow Unauthorised File Access
item.description:
Synology DSM: exploited from day 0 · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Synology DSM. The CCB advisories list the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-76954
